title: lupinus tidestromii var. layneae
intro: Lupinus tidestromii var. layneae, commonly known as Layne's lupine, is a rare and endemic variety of the lupine plant native to the southwestern United States. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in treating respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs, due to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties. The health benefits of Layne's lupine include its ability to soothe irritated tissues, reduce inflammation, and promote the removal of mucus and phlegm from the lungs. The bioactive constituents of Lupinus tidestromii var. layneae include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic effects.
